{{Top|leg}}
A '''pheromone dart''' was a projectile missile infused with the [[Pheromone/Legends|pheromones]] of the targeted prey. It was generally used in [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]], being discharged from a [[dart shooter]], and employed to attract a member of the [[Species/Legends|species]] being harvested.
